interruptRecovery.note: No sub-agents were running when the operator addendum arrived. Scope added, nothing displaced.

amendments.text: CC county manifest page (cmdcenter-blush.vercel.app #panel=county-manifest) is the customer-done probe. After canary shift it must load fully during an active drain. Stale materialization must show computedAt via the existing STALE-banner pattern. Curl-pass + console-timeout = FAIL. Expands repo scope to hauska-map (command-center) in addition to legacy-design-tools.

heavyOnRequest: probeRailCapabilities COUNT DISTINCT county_fips on cad_property (~4.6M) + txgio_parcel (~15M) + tx_special_district — this is a heavy scan on every GET
full county_facet_coverage table scan for counties[]
readManifestGrid CROSS JOIN 254 x COUNTY_RAIL_COUNT LEFT JOIN coverage (cheap; not the hang)

ccTimeout.symptom: page ErrorState 'timed out after 20000ms' while drain holds connections / seq-scans

rootCauseAsFound.staleGetClass: a hung GET returns 0 bytes; consumers keep the last successful payload (195 cells: geometry 194 + zoning 1, the pre-08-12 shape) with no computedAt stamp. No in-memory cache in the route — the silent-old-grid is the client holding the last 200.

table.name: county_ledger_snapshot
table.shape: singleton id='current' CHECK; computed_at timestamptz; payload jsonb (full GET body minus servedAt)
table.justificationVsView: JSONB snapshot of the already-gated ManifestCell[] is byte-identical to the live compute path by construction (same function at write time). A SQL materialized view would re-derive display gates and could drift from applyDepthRailDisplayGate / doctrine exclusion.

trigger.reason: materialize includes COUNT DISTINCT on txgio_parcel (heavy scan). A trigger on county_facet_coverage would fire that on every scorer upsert and serialize with L16 drains. Writer-owned CLI after scoring is the seam. Staleness is visible via computedAt, so a delayed refresh is honest rather than silent.

computeExtraction.rule: no main(); route and CLI both import it. Server must NEVER import the CLI (esbuild isDirectRun boot-crash class).

design.getDefault: SELECT snapshot; stamp servedAt + materializationAgeMs; 503 county_ledger_not_materialized if no row (fail closed, never silently compute)
design.cli: artifacts/api-server/src/countyLedgerMaterializeCli.ts --dry-run | --apply; DATABASE_URL / gcloud DEPLOYMENT_DATABASE_URL identical to countyRailRefreshCli
design.scorerSeam: export materializeCountyLedger(db) from countyLedgerCompute.ts. Do not change geometry/flood/mud scoring logic. Scorers/planner invoke the CLI after scoring.

cc.staleBanner: reuse NodeGraph pattern: warn Pill 'manifest stale' + caption 'STALE — materialized at {computedAt}' (NodeGraph.tsx tallySource==='artifact' Pill + tallyError caption). Always render computedAt in the rollup strip so a silent old grid is impossible. Banner when materializationAgeMs > 15min (LEDGER_STALE_AFTER_MS).
cc.timeout: keep 20s; after materialize GET is sub-second so the timeout is not the fix — constant-time GET is.

deployOrder: ANNOUNCE heavy scan: countyLedgerMaterializeCli --apply (COUNT DISTINCT txgio_parcel) — wait if L16 drain is mid-scan
WDLL-6: CC #panel=county-manifest loads during drain; stale shows stamp

constraints: Do NOT touch scorer CLIs scoring logic
No atoms-store access, no slot, no lease
ldt api-server tests not green locally; CI authoritative
materialize CLI COUNT DISTINCT is a heavy scan — announce before prod --apply
